# The Good Code Company

> Independent software products, built to be trusted.

The Good Code Company is a Toronto-based independent software product company.
It designs, builds, owns, and operates its own products. It does not take
client projects.

## Products

- Enoch (https://enoch.goodcode.ca/): tamper-evident records for regulated
  enterprises. In development.
